title: Klint Kubiak is optimistic about Ashton Jeanty playing Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Klint Kubiak is optimistic about Ashton Jeanty playing Week 1
sources.description: While the Raiders have characterized Ashton Jeanty as "on the mend" with his ankle injury, head coach Klint Kubiak provided a little more information on the running back in his Wednesday press conference.
